text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Thank you very much for today as well.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Yes...
I had a wonderful time.

A little time had passed since forming a
contract with Still in Love.
Training was progressing smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If we keep going like this, even more—Ah,
more, more—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, no, it's nothing...
—Haa... I'm all right.

My reflection was mirrored in Still in Love's
eyes.
Though "that child" remained inside her as
always—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Your voice,
your presence... it always...

She never once lost control.
You could even say she was completely
stable.

However,
that was strictly when it came to
training.
I still knew very little about who she was
off the track.

To properly support her moving forward,
as her Trainer,
I needed to learn more about her.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
To think that you would invite me out like
this, Trainer...
I never could have imagined... Um,
I'm... honored.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah, oh... I-I'm so sorry...
...I'm just...
not used to this sort of thing...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I seem to be...
just a little nervous...
Please, don't pay me any mind...
choice_data_list: Alright. But... you're sure it's n...
Okay. But... you're sure it's not ...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all. A bother? Never.
...After all,
just being with you like this...

I couldn't catch what her whisper-thin voice
murmured next.
Without pressing further,
I strolled leisurely through the park with
Still in Love.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...What a lovely breeze.
The rustling leaves are so soothing,
aren't they?

Even without a particular topic of
conversation,
there wasn't a hint of awkwardness.
Only a peaceful,
gentle atmosphere enveloped us.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
would you care for something to eat?
...I can go order for us, so please,
go ahead and save us a table.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me. I'd like to place an order—

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! Step right up!
Combo meals are on special today! Welcome!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: U-Um... excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Fries are fresh and ready!
Ah, takeout orders right over here—

After watching for a moment,
it was clear that
the clerk hadn't noticed Still in Love at
all.
choice_data_list: Excuse me, we'd like to order.

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: Oh, right away! What can I get for you?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...
...I'm so sorry...

Still in Love brought food to her mouth in
small, deliberate bites,
savoring every flavor.
It had already been over an hour since we
sat down.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I'm so sorry to keep you waiting.
And on top of that...
you paced yourself just to match me...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Your food must have gone cold, hasn't it?
I'm... just so slow at eating...
choice_data_list: Not at all. It's nice getting to t...
Not at all. It's nice getting to t...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Such a kind person.
Always staying close by my side,
accepting me... no matter what I am...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Is it truly alright...
for me to receive such happiness?
Am I not...
forcing a burden upon them...?)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Ah. At the very least...
I don't want to hold you back.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(So that...
I can remain by your side forever...)
